changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logos_resolve_unit_price( p_quantity text, p_model_id integer, p_provider_id integer, p_valid_at timestamptz, p_context_tokens bigint, p_service_tier text ) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $fn$ WITH chain(name, depth) AS ( SELECT p_quantity, 0 UNION ALL SELECT x.fb, x.d FROM (VALUES ('billed_input_cache_read', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write_1h', 'billed_input_cache_write', 1), ('billed_input_cache_write_1h', 'billed_input_uncached', 2), ('billed_input_audio', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_audio', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_cache_read', 2), ('billed_input_audio_cache_read','billed_input_uncached', 3), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_audio', 1), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_cache_write',2), ('billed_input_audio_cache_write','billed_input_uncached', 3), ('billed_input_image_tokens', 'billed_input_uncached', 1), ('billed_output_reasoning', 'billed_output_text', 1), ('billed_output_audio', 'billed_output_text', 1), ('billed_output_image_tokens', 'billed_output_text', 1) ,('billed_output_video_tokens', 'billed_output_text', 1) -- Most catalogues carry only the scalar search price -- (search_context_cost_per_query / input_cost_per_query). -- A request that asks for a low/high context size derives -- the size-suffixed quantity, so fall those back to the -- scalar price when no size-specific row exists. ,('billed_search_queries_low', 'billed_search_queries', 1) ,('billed_search_queries_high', 'billed_search_queries', 1) ,('billed_search_prompts_low', 'billed_search_prompts', 1) ,('billed_search_prompts_high', 'billed_search_prompts', 1) ) AS x(orig, fb, d) WHERE x.orig = p_quantity ) SELECT price.price_per_k_unit FROM chain c JOIN token_types tt ON tt.name = c.name JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tp.price_per_k_unit FROM token_prices tp WHERE tp.type_id = tt.id AND tp.unit = CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%characters' THEN 'character' WHEN c.name LIKE '%images' THEN 'image' WHEN c.name LIKE '%pixels' THEN 'pixel' WHEN c.name LIKE '%milliseconds%' OR c.name = 'audio_milliseconds' THEN 'millisecond' WHEN c.name LIKE '%pages' THEN 'page' WHEN c.name LIKE '%credits' THEN 'credit' WHEN c.name LIKE '%queries%' THEN 'query' WHEN c.name LIKE '%prompts%' THEN 'request' WHEN c.name = 'billed_requests' THEN 'request' WHEN c.name LIKE '%sessions' THEN 'session' WHEN c.name LIKE 'billed_guardrail_%' THEN 'unit' ELSE 'token' END AND (tp.model_id = p_model_id OR tp.model_id IS NULL) AND (tp.provider_id = p_provider_id OR tp.provider_id IS NULL) AND tp.valid_from <= p_valid_at AND tp.min_context_tokens <= COALESCE(p_context_tokens, 0) AND (tp.service_tier = COALESCE(p_service_tier, 'default') OR tp.service_tier = 'default') ORDER BY (tp.model_id = p_model_id) DESC NULLS LAST, (tp.provider_id = p_provider_id) DESC NULLS LAST, (tp.service_tier = COALESCE(p_service_tier, 'default')) DESC, tp.min_context_tokens DESC, tp.valid_from DESC, tp.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) price ON true ORDER BY c.depth LIMIT 1 $fn$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW log_entry_cost AS SELECT le.id AS log_entry_id, le.api_key_id AS api_key_id, le.timestamp_request AS timestamp_request, -- A completed request prices its full usage (from the frozen -- snapshot when present, else live). A failed or timed-out -- request still prices what it measurably delivered -- the -- provider bills Logos for a stream that produced tokens or -- characters and then dropped -- but never the flat per-request -- fee, nor any quantity that is only an estimate from the -- request when the response is absent: the input estimates -- (characters / pixels / images / video ms) and the output -- generation quantities that fall back to the requested count -- or duration (images, pixels, milliseconds). In-flight rows -- (result_status NULL) are not priced until they finish. NULL -- is also returned when Logos has no pricing knowledge (local -- provider, or a cloud model with no catalog price): the logs -- UI omits the cost line, budget SUM()s ignore it. CASE WHEN le.result_status = 'success' THEN COALESCE( le.settled_cost_micro_cents, logos_price_usage(le.model_id, le.provider_id, COALESCE(le.timestamp_response, le.timestamp_request), le.service_tier, pe.usage_json) ) WHEN le.result_status IN ('error', 'timeout') THEN logos_price_usage(le.model_id, le.provider_id, COALESCE(le.timestamp_response, le.timestamp_request), le.service_tier, pe.usage_json - ARRAY[ 'billed_requests', 'billed_input_characters', 'billed_input_pixels', 'billed_input_images', 'billed_input_video_milliseconds', 'billed_input_video_milliseconds_above_8s', 'billed_input_video_milliseconds_above_15s', 'billed_output_images', 'billed_output_pixels', 'billed_output_milliseconds', 'billed_output_milliseconds_1080p', 'billed_output_milliseconds_4k' ]) END AS cost_micro_cents FROM log_entry le LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(tt.name, ut.token_count) AS usage_json FROM usage_tokens ut JOIN token_types tt ON tt.id = ut.type_id WHERE ut.log_entry_id = le.id ) pe ON true;

changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW budget_usage; CREATE VIEW budget_usage AS SELECT lec.api_key_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', lec.timestamp_request)::DATE AS month, COALESCE(SUM(lec.cost_micro_cents), 0) AS cost_micro_cents FROM log_entry_cost lec WHERE lec.api_key_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lec.api_key_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', lec.timestamp_request)::DATE;
